encodingDesc.p: Printed small capitals transcribed in uppercase; ordinary line-wrap hyphenation joined explicitly; lexical hyphens, spelling, punctuation, brackets and printed footnote pointers retained. Raw digital HTML/XML, scan crops and source bytes remain recoverable. Comparisons may fold case and ae/æ; original source readings are retained without such folding.

normalization.p: Sentence-case presentation is an editorial layer, not a replacement transcription. Each choice retains the exact accepted 1856 text in orig and a case-only display in reg. Proper names, ligatures, punctuation, spelling, source pointers and Roman labels are preserved; common nouns are lowercased. Compiled-index CSS selects reg only, without altering other witnesses.

revisionDesc.change: Authorized human browser-review correction: one provenance note immediately below the index title; reversible sentence-case readings and left-aligned presentation. Original 1856 readings and existing structural identities remain intact.

div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: Compiled from the chapter headings printed in the Auburn and Rochester edition of Whiston's translation (Alden & Beardsley, 1856). The arrangement as an index is editorial, not an original printed table of contents.

choice.orig: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY-SEVEN YEARS.
choice.reg: Containing the interval of one hundred and fifty-seven years.

choice.orig: FROM THE DEATH OF AHAB TO THE CAPTIVITY OF THE TEN TRIBES.
choice.reg: From the death of Ahab to the captivity of the ten tribes.

choice.orig: CONCERNING JEHOSHAPHAT AGAIN; HOW HE CONSTITUTED JUDGES, AND, BY GOD'S ASSISTANCE, OVERCAME HIS ENEMIES.
choice.reg: Concerning Jehoshaphat again; how he constituted judges, and, by God's assistance, overcame his enemies.

choice.orig: CONCERNING AHAZIAH, THE KING OF ISRAEL; AND AGAIN CONCERNING THE PROPHET ELIJAH.
choice.reg: Concerning Ahaziah, the king of Israel; and again concerning the prophet Elijah.

choice.orig: HOW JORAM AND JEHOSHAPHAT MADE AN EXPEDITION AGAINST THE MOABITES; AS ALSO CONCERNING THE WONDERS OF ELISHA, AND THE DEATH OF JEHOSHAPHAT.
choice.reg: How Joram and Jehoshaphat made an expedition against the Moabites; as also concerning the wonders of Elisha, and the death of Jehoshaphat.

choice.orig: JEHORAM SUCCEEDS JEHOSHAPHAT; HOW JORAM, HIS NAMESAKE, KING OF ISRAEL, FOUGHT WITH THE SYRIANS; AND WHAT WONDERS WERE DONE BY THE PROPHET ELISHA.
choice.reg: Jehoram succeeds Jehoshaphat; how Joram, his namesake, king of Israel, fought with the Syrians; and what wonders were done by the prophet Elisha.

choice.orig: CONCERNING THE WICKEDNESS OF JEHORAM, KING OF JERUSALEM; HIS DEFEAT, AND DEATH.
choice.reg: Concerning the wickedness of Jehoram, king of Jerusalem; his defeat, and death.

choice.orig: HOW JEHU WAS ANOINTED KING, AND SLEW BOTH JORAM AND AHAZIAH; AS ALSO WHAT HE DID FOR THE PUNISHMENT OF THE WICKED.
choice.reg: How Jehu was anointed king, and slew both Joram and Ahaziah; as also what he did for the punishment of the wicked.

choice.orig: HOW ATHALIAH REIGNED OVER JERUSALEM FOR FIVE [SIX] YEARS, WHEN JEHOIADA THE HIGH-PRIEST SLEW HER, AND MADE JEHOASH, THE SON OF AHAZIAH, KING.
choice.reg: How Athaliah reigned over Jerusalem for five [six] years, when Jehoiada the high-priest slew her, and made Jehoash, the son of Ahaziah, king.

choice.orig: HAZAEL MAKES AN EXPEDITION AGAINST THE PEOPLE OF ISRAEL AND THE INHABITANTS OF JERUSALEM. JEHU DIES, AND JEHOAHAZ SUCCEEDS IN THE GOVERNMENT. JEHOASH, THE KING OF JERUSALEM, AT FIRST IS CAREFUL ABOUT THE WORSHIP OF GOD, BUT AFTERWARDS BECOMES IMPIOUS, AND COMMANDS ZECHARIAH TO BE STONED. WHEN JEHOASH [KING OF JUDAH] WAS DEAD, AMAZIAH SUCCEEDS HIM IN THE KINGDOM.
choice.reg: Hazael makes an expedition against the people of Israel and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Jehu dies, and Jehoahaz succeeds in the government. Jehoash, the king of Jerusalem, at first is careful about the worship of God, but afterwards becomes impious, and commands Zechariah to be stoned. When Jehoash [king of Judah] was dead, Amaziah succeeds him in the kingdom.

choice.orig: HOW AMAZIAH MADE AN EXPEDITION AGAINST THE EDOMITES AND AMALEKITES, AND CONQUERED THEM; BUT WHEN HE AFTERWARDS MADE WAR AGAINST JOASH, HE WAS BEATEN, AND NOT LONG AFTER WAS SLAIN; AND UZZIAH SUCCEEDED IN THE GOVERNMENT.
choice.reg: How Amaziah made an expedition against the Edomites and Amalekites, and conquered them; but when he afterwards made war against Joash, he was beaten, and not long after was slain; and Uzziah succeeded in the government.

choice.orig: CONCERNING JEROBOAM, KING OF ISRAEL, AND JONAH, THE PROPHET; AND HOW, AFTER THE DEATH OF JEROBOAM, HIS SON ZECHARIAH TOOK THE GOVERNMENT. HOW UZZIAH, KING OF JERUSALEM, SUBDUED THE NATIONS THAT WERE ROUND ABOUT HIM, AND WHAT BEFELL HIM WHEN HE ATTEMPTED TO OFFER INCENSE TO GOD.
choice.reg: Concerning Jeroboam, king of Israel, and Jonah, the prophet; and how, after the death of Jeroboam, his son Zechariah took the government. How Uzziah, king of Jerusalem, subdued the nations that were round about him, and what befell him when he attempted to offer incense to God.

choice.orig: HOW ZECHARIAH, SHALLUM, MENAHEM, PEKAHIAH, AND PEKAH, TOOK THE GOVERNMENT OVER THE ISRAELITES; AND HOW PUL AND TIGLATH-PILESER MADE AN EXPEDITION AGAINST THE ISRAELITES. HOW JOTHAM, THE SON OF UZZIAH, REIGNED OVER THE TRIBE OF JUDAH; AND WHAT THINGS NAHUM PROPHESIED AGAINST THE ASSYRIANS.
choice.reg: How Zechariah, Shallum, Menahem, Pekahiah, and Pekah, took the government over the Israelites; and how Pul and Tiglath-Pileser made an expedition against the Israelites. How Jotham, the son of Uzziah, reigned over the tribe of Judah; and what things Nahum prophesied against the Assyrians.

choice.orig: HOW, UPON THE DEATH OF JOTHAM, AHAZ REIGNED IN HIS STEAD; AGAINST WHOM REZIN, KING OF SYRIA, AND PEKAH, KING OF ISRAEL, MADE WAR; AND HOW TIGLATH-PILESER, KING OF ASSYRIA, CAME TO THE ASSISTANCE OF AHAZ, AND LAID SYRIA WASTE, AND REMOVING THE DAMASCENS INTO MEDIA, PLACED OTHER NATIONS IN THEIR ROOM.
choice.reg: How, upon the death of Jotham, Ahaz reigned in his stead; against whom Rezin, king of Syria, and Pekah, king of Israel, made war; and how Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, came to the assistance of Ahaz, and laid Syria waste, and removing the Damascens into Media, placed other nations in their room.

choice.orig: HOW PEKAH DIED BY THE TREACHERY OF HOSHEA, WHO WAS A LITTLE AFTER SUBDUED BY SHALMANESER; AND HOW HEZEKIAH REIGNED INSTEAD OF AHAZ; AND WHAT ACTIONS OF PIETY AND JUSTICE HE DID.
choice.reg: How Pekah died by the treachery of Hoshea, who was a little after subdued by Shalmaneser; and how Hezekiah reigned instead of Ahaz; and what actions of piety and justice he did.

choice.orig: HOW SHALMANESER TOOK SAMARIA BY FORCE, AND HOW HE TRANSPLANTED THE TEN TRIBES INTO MEDIA, AND BROUGHT THE NATION OF THE CUTHEANS INTO THEIR COUNTRY [IN THEIR ROOM].
choice.reg: How Shalmaneser took Samaria by force, and how he transplanted the ten tribes into Media, and brought the nation of the Cutheans into their country [in their room].
